text:
Priya Patel: Heads up — candidate (Emma L.) got verbal offer. Recruiter asks for a 2-part sign-on: $10k now, $15k after 90 days, and an earlier start date that would put benefits eligibility after 30 days instead of the standard 60. Need approvals for sign-on structure and benefits proration, and confirm whether a comp-band uplift is required.
Jonah Kim: Do we already have approval envelope in band? Hiring manager ok with split sign-on if legal & finance sign off. I can sign off on accelerated start.
Miguel Rivera: FYI comp band for SDE3 is 160-200k, sign-on typical <= 20k. This is 25k total so above standard. Need comp-exception form and justification (market/retention). Benefits proration — benefits team needs a start-date change request to frontload coverage.
Aisha Gomez: Finance — can we structure the second payment as a retention bonus on payroll at 90d? If yes, taxes/withholding handled normally, but we need PO and cost center. Also need to confirm payroll timeline for processing one-off retention payments.
Priya Patel: @Miguel can you populate the comp-exception template? I'll attach candidate packet. Also @Elena Wu (Legal) — any concerns about split payment language for offer letter and immigration implications if start date shifts?
Elena Wu: Quick check — split sign-on is acceptable. Recommend clause: 'Second installment contingent on continued employment and performance at 90 days.' Also add immigration note: if visa sponsorship timing changes, payment timing may be adjusted. I can draft the clause and attach to the offer.
Miguel Rivera: I've uploaded a draft comp-exception form to the internal folder (link placeholder). Rationale: market premium for this role, retention risk from competing offers, candidate prefers earlier start. Requesting Comp Committee review.
Aisha Gomez: Conditional approval from Finance: ok with two installments structured as sign-on + retention bonus. Need PO, cost center, and approval chain. @Jonah please confirm cost center.
Jonah Kim: Cost center ENG-PLAT-441 confirmed.
Priya Patel: @HR Bot — please route this to the Comp Committee and notify Benefits and Payroll teams for proration & scheduling. :pray:
HR Bot: routing: comp-committee@redwood scheduled; benefits-team notified; payroll flagged for retention bonus setup.
Miguel Rivera: Comp Committee update: approved (3-0) for a $25k total sign-on split as proposed. Conditions: retention clause in offer, taxes handled by payroll, and a PO issued by Finance. I'll update the comp-exception record with committee minutes.
Priya Patel: Great — next steps: I'll add Elena's clause to the offer, finalize the language with Jonah, send to candidate for signature, and coordinate with Aisha for PO and payroll setup. Target to finalize by EOD tomorrow.
Jonah Kim: Sounds good. Will expedite on our side.
Aisha Gomez: I'll create the PO once the signed offer is in hand and coordinate with payroll for the 90-day retention payment flow.
Priya Patel: Closing thread — will ping if anything blocks. Thanks everyone! :tada:
